title: The AI Scientist-v2: a fully generated paper passes a workshop review
summary: A paper produced end to end by the system received a mean score of 6.33 at the ICBINB workshop at ICLR 2025, above the average acceptance threshold. Humans only supplied the topic and selected three papers to submit, and the accepted one was withdrawn. Only one of three cleared the threshold; it was a workshop, not the main conference, and there was no meta-review.

evidence.tested: Three AI-generated papers went through double-blind review at an ICLR 2025 workshop, and one scored 6.33 on average, above the acceptance threshold.
evidence.unknown: The source states it was a workshop rather than the main track, there was no meta-review, and the authors' own review found none of the papers met the main-track bar.
evidence.ai_role: The system generated the papers end to end from a human-supplied topic, and humans chose which three to submit.
